statement: You are given an integer array nums.
An element is a leader if no element to its right is strictly greater than it. The last element is always a leader, since nothing follows it.
Return all leaders in the order they appear in nums, from left to right.

examples.explanation: Nothing to the right of 17 is greater than it, and the same holds for 5 and for 2, the last element. 16, 4 and 3 each have a larger value somewhere to their right.
The values decrease from left to right, so every element is greater than everything after it and all five are leaders.
